== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Karoshan Alliance]] is a small political entity composed of the [[Karoshan Empire]] and several [[Visiri]] planets. Despite its limited size, it is considered a potent force. The Alliance's public perception of the [[Zenith]] starship known as [[The Last Horizon]] is often negative, with reports on its [[Subline]] characterizing the vessel as a bringer of [[destruction]] and a harbinger of disaster for both the [[Free Worlds]] and the [[Union]]. However, members of the Alliance, such as [[Commander]] Queen Shyrax{{!}}Shyrax, have been known to lend their strength to the ship's cause.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Alliance is an established organization that previously employed [[Jan]] for freelance assignments. The group maintains a deep hatred for both the narrator and Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion, a prominent representative of [[Visiria]] who remains unaffiliated with them. Currently, the Alliance has issued warrants for the narrator and their companions. Their military equipment includes rifles that are equipped with magical shielding.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|[[Jan]] used to do freelance work for the Alliance.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c9">''The Knight'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The narrator and their companions are wanted in the Alliance.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c11">''The Knight'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Rifles issued by the Alliance are magically shielded.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c12">''The Knight'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Alliance hates the narrator and Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c13">''The Knight'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Raion Raithe{{!}}Raion is a prominent representative of [[Visiria]] who is not part of the Alliance.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c14">''The Knight'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
